question: If a National Emergency is in place under Article 352, then the Parliament can extend the term of the Legislative Assemblies for _________ at a time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**upto one year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Emergency** under **Article 352** is declared when there is a threat to the security of India or any part of it due to war, external aggression, or armed rebellion.
 
• During a National Emergency, the **Parliament gains extraordinary powers** to legislate and take decisions impacting the entire nation.
 
• Under this emergency provision, the **term of the Legislative Assemblies** can be extended by the Parliament for **up to one year** at a time, ensuring governance continuity during the crisis.
 
• This extension is permissible only while the National Emergency is in effect, and it cannot exceed six months after the emergency is lifted.
